Handler pairs and some small changes
The desk is glad to help later this week
Travelers, please check your animal booking details before you arrive at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Handlers keep things calm and gentle so pets settle in well, and we share clear guidance before departure. <<FACT F072>> If you are traveling with a larger animal, please review the service note sent with your booking and bring the needed papers with you.

For travelers bringing a pet in the cabin or in cargo, the main thing is to arrive prepared and keep the crate, leash, and documents easy to reach. <<FACT F057>> We will help you sort out the steps in plain words and keep the process steady for you and your animal.

If you need a quick check on forms, crate fit, or handoff points, please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
